extras.textures: PBR 4096px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: desktop CPU in LGA package, 37.5 x 45 mm, shown as a pair (top and bottom)
extras.notes: two identical processors: left one with the nickel heat spreader up, right one flipped to show the gold land grid contact field (baked texture) with the capacitor island; green substrate with orientation notches, gold pin-one triangle and SMD capacitors; no text, no logos, no moving parts

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
